incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGERDUTY: page fired (HIGH) - inference-api-eu-west - 5xx spike - incident PD#12345 - auto-escalate in 2m if unacked. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/12345

pagerbot: duplicate alert from pagerduty: service=inference-api-eu-west, symptom=5xx_rate>20% over 60s, affected-route=/v1/generate

Alex K: acking and taking this. jumping on bridge (voice) in 30s. :raising_hand:

Maria S: thanks alex. i'll prep customer comms and coordinate routing fallbacks. which pool is hit?

Alex K: metrics show spike from model_shard-2 pods svc->model-backend timeouts. 5xx mostly 502/504. seq of errors started ~3168000600.

Tyler D: saw a KV-cache eviction storm earlier on kvm-4; could be cascading. quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=model-shard -o wide`

Alex K: running live tail of logs now. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T11:07:12Z] model-shard-2 PID=4821 - grpc: upstream timeout after 10s
[2026-03-15T11:07:13Z] model-shard-3 PID=4950 - 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-03-15T11:07:14Z] kvcache: eviction spike, freed 12MB keys/sec
```

Sunita R: pinging infra to see if there was a node OOM or recent kube restart. I already see a couple of recent restarts on node eu-west-3b-07.

incident-bot: NOTE: If no PD ack in 90s this will auto-escalate to next rotation.

Alex K: quick mitigation plan: 1) drain model_shard-2 on node eu-west-3b-07 2) scale model-shard replicas +2 3) shift a small % of traffic to model-quantized fallback. executing now.

Tyler D: +1. command to scale: `kubectl scale deploy/model-shard --replicas=6 -n inference`

Maria S: drafting customer note: "We're investigating elevated 5xx rates in EU region impacting text generation. We're actively mitigating and will update within 30 minutes." want to add estimated impact numbers. Alex, do you have % failure?

Alex K: approx 35% failed requests for EU region in last 10m; p95 latency ~2.2s -> 4.8s. adding to comms.

Alex K: executed scale, restarted pods on eu-west-3b-07, and added routing rule to divert 10% traffic to `model-quantized-v1` as fallback.

pagerbot: PD#12345 updated: acknowledged by Alex K. escalation suppressed.

Maria S: posting initial customer update to status page and support queue. message sent to top 50 customers flagged as impacted.

Tyler D: heads up - after scale there is a transient increase in errors during warmup. expect a small blip for ~2m.

Alex K: Monitoring: 5xx dropping from 35% -> 8% over past 3m. latency p95 back to ~2.5s. attaching graph: https://grafana.internal/boards/xyz?panel=503

Sunita R: infra confirm: node eu-west-3b-07 had a kubelet restart at 11:04 UTC due to kernel OOM killer on a noisy ML job. we've cordoned the node and will reprovision.

Maria S: good root-cause pointer. i'll add OOM detail to incident notes. prepping next customer update: ETA to full recovery 30-45m.

incident-bot: incident timeline note added by Alex K. Please remember to open a postmortem ticket: /pm create inference-5xx-eu-20260315

Alex K: handing back PD ownership to rotation. i've left an incident runbook checklist in the ticket. TL;DR: mitigated by node reprovision + scaled replicas + traffic diversion. :white_check_mark:

Maria S: thanks everyone. I'll monitor comms and post a follow-up 30m. assigning action items: Sunita -> infra follow-up + node reprovision, Tyler -> verify autoscaler thresholds haven't regressed, Alex -> postmortem and remediation PR for runaway ML job.

Alex K: final check: 5xx now ~1.2%, latency stable. i am clearing my bridge in 10m. if anything else pops up re-add PD page. handing to rotation at 12:30 UTC. :wave:
__meta: generated by dataset-gen: production incident thread about PD page, ack, mitigation, handoff and customer comms
